# Error #94: RefundTargetNotSender

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#94`
- **Variant Name**: `RefundTargetNotSender`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `ERROR`
- **Retryable**: `No`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::RefundTargetNotSender` — the caller is not the stream's current sender, so they do not own the deposit being routed.

---

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::only_the_current_sender_can_re_route_the_refund`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::only_the_current_sender_can_re_route_the_refund). ## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Call `set_refund_target` as the stream's current sender; the sender owns the deposit being re-routed.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#20-refund-routing`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#20-refund-routing)
